sizes.tread: closed box 280 x 50 (same outside): 3 top (serrated) / 2 bottom / 2 walls + 2 inner webs 2 at x 95 and 185 (tread_box2 B4, FE with loads on the deck): 4 kN 0.41 (0.82 with every seam welded), sag 3.6 mm, crowd 1.2 mm, about 5.9 kg per step. Top and walls bent from one sheet; bottom welded or riveted. Open shapes (cut-out top sheet, cut lattice) fail.
sizes.tread_minimum_I: I >= 176,000 mm4 for 4 kN / L/100 and >= 157,000 mm4 for crowd L/250 - with a CLOSED section (no twist)
sizes.pole_solid_6082: solid 25 (along) x 55 (across): 0.84 at the worst barrier load; tapered 55 -> 15 at the top saves 15 kg per unit; stands on the outside face of the rails, bolted to both (a 55 mm pole can't pass through a 35 mm rail). The pole couple (~14 kN) needs the 65 mm rails.
sizes.tread_pins: O20 aluminium 6082-T6 (shear 44 kN, M_Rd 235 kNmm) or O16 steel 8.8, for 11.8 kN + 165 kNmm
sizes.latch_pins: pole pegs O12 (each reaches 7.5 mm to the rail wall: bending 0.58, shear 0.18), 2 per rail, 4 per pole; draw the upper pair
sizes.axle: hooks lock, so the base can end up anywhere between free and held: size for held. Base axle O45x5 (0.96), or jacks straight under the hooks with O30x3; top axle O40x4 (0.94). Free base only: O35x3 / O30x3
sizes.hooks: 10 mm plate ring width >= 57.5 mm at the base, >= 40.0 mm at the top (now about 22)
sizes.hook_locks: not drawn. As drawn the base hook opens on the side the stair pushes, so the lock carries the base reaction: 6.4 kN (base free) to 17.7 kN (base held) per side; top lock 11.3 kN (incl. 3.2 kN uplift). E.g. O14 keeper pin in single shear (21.8 kN) at the base, O12 (16.0 kN) at the top; better: turn the base hook so the plate sits on top of the axle
sizes.jacks: held base: M30 rods (0.88) and a fixing to the ground/scaffold for 10.9 kN sideways per side (friction needs 0.77, about 0.5 available)
sizes.footplate: 150 x 150 x 8 (R73; 0.89 with the held-base rod moment)
sizes.rail_hole_lo_r: Lo_R hole centre >= 15.2 mm above the free edge of the leg (now 12.5) for the top-tread link force
sizes.rails: net section at the pin stations must reach W >= 2,900 mm3 (now 216-595 mm3): about 5 x; or add a mid support and a proper fold lock, then re-run

lo_r_hole_edge.rule: EN 1999-1-1 T8.8: a >= F gMp/(2 t f0) + 2 d0/3, a = hole edge to free edge = 12.5 - 5 = 7.5 mm, t 5, d0 10
